scope: No new numerical work, GPU, timing, or utilization sampling. Phase comparisons only within their original cohorts.

thin_high_t72.scope: Observed Python process scope with GPU preflight endpoints; complete lifecycle coverage is unavailable.
thin_high_t72.clock_note: The solver clock includes model release and excludes the spatial signature. The fresh clock also includes interpreter, imports, admission, signatures and receipt. Serialization after SAVE and independent score are outside both.

fused_t9.scope: Sequential bounded diagnostic, no paired fresh-return measure and no isolated ranking.
fused_t9.scope_note: NVRTC plus driver load is a nested component of runtime init. Its delta must not be added to runtime init or attributed wholly to NVRTC.

ptx.scope_note: Verified hits bypass source-to-PTX NVRTC. Initial artifact generation, IO, driver loading and possible driver JIT remain. CPU compiler timing does not establish a GPU solve speedup.

interpretations.rust: Changing only host-language wrappers does not change the operations of the same CUDA/cuFFT/BLAS/LAPACK routines. There is no matched Rust wall-clock result.
interpretations.stage_upper_bound: The zero-stage ratios are per-row accounting thought experiments with all remaining work unchanged. Neither a measured minimum nor a predicted reachable speed. NVRTC is only a subset of runtime init.
interpretations.utilization: The historical latency benchmark is serial and single-core pinned for each child. One of 32 logical processors is a count-based scale only. Aggregate CPU utilization and same-gate time-to-solution measure different things.
interpretations.throughput: Simultaneous independent GPU jobs have not been measured under a matched field gate in this round. Report qualified solves per elapsed wall time if such a separate throughput experiment exists.
